title: 6/12 entry check v1 reported the entered pick as 'not entered' (settled-only profile endpoint); cron disabled the same night
tier_reason: a false 'not entered' result for a pick that had been entered; the check was removed from cron within hours and no entry or state was affected

contract.text: check-pick-entered reports 'not entered' only when the delivered pick is absent from the contest account, pending same-day entries included.
contract.source: 4f13eb3 check_pick_entered docstring ('DM if today's delivered pick was never entered in the MLB app'); ARCHITECTURE.md 'bts check-pick-entered' (v1 disabled: profile source is SETTLED-only)

mechanism.text: check_pick_entered v1 decided entry from contest_fetch.has_prediction_for over the user-profile predictions array, which holds only settled rows (hit/not_hit/void); a pending same-day entry is invisible there, so inside the pre-pitch window an entered pick read as not entered

mitigated.action: check-pick-entered cron line removed on the box and from scripts/cron-setup-hetzner.sh (2d68102); command kept but marked disabled

residual.text: With v1 disabled (6/12 → v2 on 7/04), a missed entry had only the noon-ET contest_state WARN, which is logged but not DM'd (see I-061).
residual.source: 2d68102 body; a1b7e75 ARCHITECTURE note; closed by a6ec548/720651a

watchdog.trigger: a 'not entered' result or DM for a date on which the contest account's pending predictions (api/predictions) show the delivered selection entered; equivalently, an entry source that returns no pending row on a day with a known entry
watchdog.recovery_assertion: on the next pre-pitch run the check reports 'confirmed' for an entered delivered selection (a live positive control) and no 'not entered' DM is sent

evidence.what: Eric HAD entered the 06-12 pick, but the profile predictions list contains only hit/not_hit/void rows, so the check would false-alarm daily; cron line removed (box + setup script)
'caught by Eric within hours: he HAD entered the 06-12 pick and the check still said no'
v2 sources entry from the union of the profile and GET api/predictions, which exposes the own pending same-day row (verified live 7/03); fetch failures skip without consuming the marker
pre-deploy 2c62d72 -> deployed 720651a at 2026-07-04T03:07:46Z, canary passed: v2 code and its cron line first installed
first successful deploy run whose head (4f13eb3) contains the v1 check, created 2026-06-12T23:22:24Z; log expired

notes: whether the false result reached Eric as a cron DM or from a manual run is not stated ('the check still said no'); the v1 cron was installed on the box (2d68102 removed it there) after the 19:22 ET deploy candidate (ev5) — Route R: journal/cron.log + data/health_state/pick_entry_check.json (latest-state only) for 6/12

onset is bounded to 6/12 before the disable commit; the likely window is after the 4f13eb3 deploy (run 27448741736 created 23:22Z = 19:22 ET) — kept date-only because a pre-commit manual run cannot be excluded
alert fields are not_applicable: the symptom IS the false 'not entered' result

defective ref = 4f13eb3 (v1 as shipped); 2d68102 only disabled it — the fix is v2 (a6ec548 + cron 720651a). v2 cron activation needs a box-side install (720651a body) that is not dated; the 7/06 premature DM (I-071) shows it running by then
classes: primary A (false alarm), secondary E (entry verification); the row had E/A
fixtures: filled from Task 5/6 acceptance objects at build time; a6ec548 adds pending-row tests (tests/test_contest_fetch.py, tests/test_cli_integration.py) that encode the corrected source
